## @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-control-center 0.1.0

> **Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 exactly.** Do not install this package on rc1 or older DSH builds. Pre-rc2 users should stay on `@stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab@0.5.1`.

First release of the **rc2-only Automation Tasks Enhancer**. It upgrades the shipped `Automation tasks` presentation in place instead of adding another Schedule tab.

This is a new package, not a compatibility update of `@stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab`. The old package remains for pre-rc2 DSH installations.

### Native rc2 architecture

- Exact peer: `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.7-rc.2`.
- Reads the authoritative Host-wide `schedule.catalog()` only.
- No legacy Session Schedule projections, no `refreshProjections()`, and no `scheduleTabBootstrap`.
- Enables the shipped rc2 `time-context`, `schedule`, and `ui-schedule` rows instead of creating alternate Schedule instances.
- Uses `schedule/changed` and connection reset as authoritative catalog invalidations.
- Ignores late catalog responses after a newer read has started.

### Native Automation tasks enhancement

- Reuses and shadows the native `schedules` main/sidebar cells through slot priority; no extra `Schedule+` navigation item.
- Keeps the native sidebar position and label: **Automation tasks**.
- Active / All / Inactive / Today / Overdue / Recurring filters.
- Date or conversation grouping.
- Search by task title, instruction, id, Session id, or current Session title.
- Every / Daily / Weekly / Cron formatting with stored IANA zones.
- Notification-style sidebar unread/active counter and warning state.
- Native rc2 Session Schedule marks receive the same unseen/warning coloring.
- Inactive one-shot tasks remain inspectable.

### Delivery history

- Native paged `schedule.history()` reads, 20 receipts at a time.
- Occurrence time and durable inbox acknowledgment time are shown separately.
- Recurring occurrence times use the task's stored timezone.
- Saved prompt snapshots and message IDs are displayed; message IDs can be copied.
- Invalid cursors get a dedicated refresh path.
- Loaded records stay visible after a later history-read failure.
- Confirmed pruning shows the Host-provided retention limits only after the last non-empty page is reached.

### Management

- Native hard deletion through `schedule.delete()` with confirmation and authoritative readback.
- New reminder starts a Session, matching rc2's model-driven creation flow.
- Clicking a card opens its source Session plus the native `scheduleTask` right-Sidebar detail.
- The edit icon stays in Automation tasks and opens an in-place Rules pane; the history icon opens the same pane on Delivery records.
- The in-place Rules pane preserves native rc2 management semantics through public APIs: title/prompt updates, Once/Every/Daily/Mon–Fri/Weekly/Cron, date/time/IANA zone, weekday editing, interval units, compare-and-update conflicts, inactive read-only state, Save/Cancel, and dirty-field merging after catalog refreshes.
- The redundant separate Conversation button is removed; card navigation already covers that path.
- Session availability is still checked before opening native detail.

### Explicit non-features

- No legacy migration/fallback code.
- No Pause/Resume or Run now (rc2 does not provide them).
- No invented execution-success status: delivery receipts only confirm durable inbox delivery.
